items.claim: Stan Dorsonville carries his physical strength well from round to round.
items.quote: physically strong is that he does carry that strength over from round to round.

items.claim: Gage Young lacks killer instinct and plays with his food when he has opponents hurt.
items.quote: He would hurt him and then he would sit there and and wave him back up. He'd sit there and he'd do a little dance. He'd sit there and he'd play with his food. Everyone was saying this guy lacks killer instinct.

items.claim: Stan Dorsonville is bigger and stronger than Gage Young and should be able to muscle him in the clinch.
items.quote: he's stronger bigger bigger and stronger than than Gage Young, should be able to muscle him around in the clinch a little bit.

items.claim: Wes Schultz gashes way too much in his fights.
items.quote: Wes Schultz just gas is way too much for my liking.

items.claim: Wes Schultz has a nasty submission game and can snatch up a neck if fights go to the ground.
items.quote: the guy does have a nasty submission game and usually that's his path of victory is to snatch up on something.

items.claim: Jackson McVey's takedown defense and submission defense do not look all that good.
items.quote: I'm more concerned with his takedown defense and his submission defense because really the only two things that Wes Schultz excels at is like he can wrestle.

items.claim: Elise Reed has been finished in all five of her professional losses.
items.quote: Elise Reed when she loses all five losses she's been finished.
